stories.headline: Miliband says Britain won't tolerate threats on our soil, as Iran ambassador summoned
stories.description: The prime minister says Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard "almost certainly" directed the RAF Fairford incident.

stories.headline: Deadly gold mine air strikes highlight Egypt-Sudan border insecurity
stories.description: Deadly air raids on gold miners in Sudan expose deepening border lawlessness and regional instability.

stories.headline: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
stories.description: An overnight hack on hundreds of stores spoiled millions of euros in fresh and frozen food.

stories.headline: US agents search home of Ilhan Omar, Trump critic and Congress member
stories.description: US authorities searched the Democratic congresswoman’s home as part of a criminal investigation.

stories.headline: Iran sets crosshairs on ‘US-UAE’ oil shuttle out of Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The IRGC is hitting more ships allegedly part of a shuttle operation to move crude oil beyond the Strait of Hormuz.
